query:
UPDATE stripe_event_cursor
            SET state = CASE WHEN generation = $4
                    THEN 'idle'::stripe_cursor_state
                    ELSE 'dirty'::stripe_cursor_state
                END,
                next_attempt_at = now(),
                attempts = 0,
                locked_by = NULL,
                locked_until = NULL,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE consumer = ($1::text)::stripe_consumer AND ordering_key = $2 AND locked_by = $3
